status: R1 ratchet plus R2 classification for offers, interviews, operations, system, providers, reevaluations, candidate CRUD, project lifecycle, evidence and runtime lifecycle.
rule: live_mutations - classified MUST NOT exceed baseline_unclassified. Adding a mutation route therefore fails the contract test until it is classified or this baseline is raised in review.

classified.response: offer view with offer_id, candidate_id, project_id, status
classified.concurrency: none - create-only, no If-Match or expected revision
classified.human_actor: yes - actor defaults to human; the offer is never created by AI
classified.invariants: candidate must exist (404) and be in interview or offer stage (409 invariant_conflict)
classified.side_effects: creates one OfferRecord row plus one audit event in the same transaction

classified.request: status (required), actor, reason, expected_status (optional; Browser provides it)
classified.response: offer view with the new status
classified.concurrency: optional expected_status uses an atomic SQL WHERE status compare-and-set; stale returns 409 without audit. Legacy omission remains unguarded; no general revision token yet.
classified.audit: OFFER_STATUS_CHANGED with from/to status and candidate_id
classified.invariants: status must be a known OFFER_STATES value and must follow the allowed transition table (409 invariant_conflict)
classified.side_effects: mutates OfferRecord.status plus one audit event in the same transaction

classified.request: event_type (required), title, notes, source_id, metadata{questions,feedback}, scheduled_at, duration_minutes, interviewer, location, event_state, outcome, actor
classified.concurrency: none - create-only, no If-Match or expected revision
classified.invariants: event_type and event_state are whitelisted (409); a cited source must exist (404) and belong to the same candidate (409); metadata criterion_key must exist in the published protocol
classified.side_effects: a completed phone_screen/interview/feedback with questions or feedback auto-publishes a structured Source and a MaterialRevision inside the same transaction

classified.request: any of metadata, event_state, outcome, notes, scheduled_at, duration_minutes, interviewer, location, actor
classified.concurrency: none observed - no If-Match; two clients editing the same event race last-write-wins
classified.invariants: event_state whitelisted; a completed structured event keeps its cited Source in agreement with the event text
classified.side_effects: when the structured text changes, publishes a new Source with supersedes_source_id and a new MaterialRevision; the old Source and revision stay immutable; identical text is idempotent and publishes nothing

classified.concurrency: state-based lock: a submitted scorecard cannot be overwritten by the same evaluator (409); no revision token across evaluators
classified.human_actor: yes - the evaluator is the human author and is recorded on the audit event
classified.invariants: feedback must be a non-empty array of validated entries; each evaluator keeps an independent scorecard
classified.side_effects: upserts one scorecard row per (event, evaluator)

classified.concurrency: none - status comparison only; cancelling a succeeded task is a reported no-op
classified.audit: none written by this route (task state only)
classified.human_actor: implicit - anyone able to reach the local Core
classified.invariants: unknown task 404; succeeded task returns its actual status instead of mutating
classified.side_effects: sets cancel_requested, status=cancelled and cancels the linked JobEngine job

classified.concurrency: idempotency key task:{id}:retry:{attempt+1} prevents duplicate job creation per attempt
classified.invariants: unknown task 404; a cancelled task cannot be retried (409)
classified.side_effects: enqueues or requeues a job and resets task error/finish fields

classified.invariants: name is required (409); payload is coerced to an object
classified.side_effects: inserts one RoleTemplate

classified.invariants: unknown template 404; payload must be an object (409)
classified.side_effects: mutates the template row

classified.invariants: unknown template 404
classified.side_effects: deletes the template row; projects already created from it keep their own protocol

classified.concurrency: none - reads the newest draft or published revision
classified.invariants: unknown project 404; a project with no protocol cannot produce a template (409)
classified.side_effects: inserts one RoleTemplate carrying a copy of the protocol payload

classified.concurrency: none - edits the newest draft, no If-Match
classified.audit: recorded as protocol provenance {origin: template_apply, template_id, mode}
classified.invariants: unknown template/project 404 (template first); mode must be merge or replace (409); a draft is forked when none exists
classified.side_effects: creates or mutates a draft ProtocolRevision; published revisions are never touched

classified.concurrency: none - each call creates a new archive
classified.audit: implied by the archive manifest; no audit event written by the route
classified.invariants: the archive must pass the same manifest validation used at startup
classified.side_effects: writes a zip containing SQLite plus Source blobs into data/backups

classified.concurrency: single marker file; last writer wins
classified.audit: none written here; the restore itself is recorded at startup
classified.human_actor: implicit - restart_required makes the operator act
classified.invariants: unknown file 404; archive manifest and member allowlist are validated (409 on BackupTruthError); backup schema must be <= current V1_SCHEMA_REVISION
classified.side_effects: writes data/pending_restore.json only. Live data is untouched until restart, by design

classified.invariants: cancelling with no pending restore is a reported no-op
classified.side_effects: removes data/pending_restore.json if present

classified.response: profiles map with api_key_configured booleans; never the key
classified.invariants: provider name must be text_ai/ocr/asr (404); string fields must be strings (409)
classified.side_effects: updates the provider profile row and, when api_key is present, writes the key to SecretStore only

classified.concurrency: none; outbound call with a 30s timeout
classified.invariants: a missing key is provider_not_ready (409); upstream failure is provider_failure (502) and must not echo the key
classified.side_effects: one outbound provider request from the local Core; no database write

classified.concurrency: none on the draft itself; the draft snapshots the current decision context hash and is invalidated later, not now
classified.invariants: criterion_key must exist in the published protocol (409); status and evidence_level are whitelisted; the diff baseline is the latest prior human judgment per key, not only current-context judgments
classified.side_effects: creates one ReevaluationDraft plus one audit event; no assessment is written yet

classified.concurrency: context-hash guard: if the protocol or material changed since the draft, the draft becomes stale and the call returns 409; re-applying an applied draft is idempotent
classified.human_actor: assessments are recorded with actor human:reevaluation; a HumanDecision is never written here
classified.invariants: draft must exist (404) and be in draft state; context hash must still match
classified.side_effects: writes pre_ and post_reevaluation EvaluationSnapshots and updates CriterionJudgments inside one transaction

classified.invariants: display_name required; project must exist
classified.side_effects: inserts one Candidate row

classified.invariants: unknown candidate 404
classified.side_effects: sets archived flag; reversible via restore

classified.invariants: unknown candidate 404; a merged source identity cannot be restored (409) - the operator must open the canonical candidate
classified.side_effects: clears the archived flag

classified.human_actor: yes - actor defaults to human and is stored in contact provenance
classified.invariants: user_confirmed must be a boolean (409); confirmed_fields is emptied when user_confirmed is false
classified.side_effects: upserts CandidateContact, mirrors display_name onto the candidate, writes provenance and one audit event

classified.audit: written by change_project_status inside the domain service
classified.invariants: status must be a value the domain state machine accepts (409)
classified.side_effects: updates project status plus its audit event

classified.audit: PROJECT_STATUS_CHANGED via the domain service with reason 'project archived'
classified.invariants: archive is a status transition, not a direct column write, so legality and audit still apply
classified.side_effects: status becomes archived

classified.invariants: unknown project 404; target status is open only when a protocol revision exists, otherwise draft - a restored project must not claim more progress than it has
classified.side_effects: status becomes open or draft

classified.request: job setup fields accepted by update_job_setup
classified.audit: depends on update_job_setup; not asserted by this route
classified.invariants: validation lives in the recruiting domain service
classified.side_effects: updates the project draft protocol payload

classified.human_actor: suggestion only; the operator must accept it
classified.invariants: unknown project 404
classified.side_effects: none - read-only suggestion

classified.audit: no audit event; the Source row and optional MaterialRevision are the record
classified.invariants: text_content required (422); publish_material=true requires an existing candidate and publishes a revision only when the source is not already current
classified.side_effects: inserts a Source; with publish_material it also writes a MaterialRevision

classified.response: extraction result with claims and AI run ledger
classified.audit: AI run ledger (start/finish/fail) records provider, model and privacy metadata
classified.human_actor: implicit - extraction proposes, a human still reviews each claim
classified.invariants: source and candidate must exist (404); the source must belong to the candidate (409); text is privacy-projected before leaving the process
classified.side_effects: writes claims, the AI run ledger, and finishes the run with success or failure

classified.audit: claim confirmation state plus authority are persisted on the Claim
classified.human_actor: yes - actor defaults to human and is recorded as the confirming authority
classified.invariants: accepted must be a boolean (422); unknown claim 404
classified.side_effects: sets confirmation_state and authority on the claim

classified.request: header X-SRW-Session when the host issued a lifecycle token
classified.concurrency: none - the callback runs in a background task after the response
classified.human_actor: implicit - only a supervised host registers the callback
classified.invariants: 403 when a lifecycle token exists and the header does not match; 409 when no shutdown callback is registered, so an unsupervised server cannot be stopped from a browser
classified.side_effects: schedules the host callback in a BackgroundTask; the process exits only if the host agrees
